tracks.title: พี่เลี้ยงบ้านเฮา
tracks.genre: Isan lam ruang story-lam dance song (group-lam band, fast storytelling groove)
tracks.subject: Noi, a Roi Et nanny in a Bangkok townhouse, has taught three-year-old Ton to say 'saep nua' at the dinner table, and at his school recital he says it into the microphone while his mother turns pale

tracks.title: ปลาไม่กินเบ็ด
tracks.genre: 1980s Thai hard-rock sing-along with Thai-scale riffs and shouted chorus (big-guitar pub rock)
tracks.subject: Uncle Daeng sits at the same canal bank every Sunday and has hooked only one rubber sandal, which he now brings home and lines up beside the other 'catches' on his shelf

tracks.title: ก้าวคู่ที่สวนลุม
tracks.genre: Thai slow jazz-blues (12-bar minor blues with Hammond organ and muted trumpet)
tracks.subject: A woman in her fifties at the dawn tai chi circle in Lumphini Park has been copying the slow moves of the man opposite her for a year, and today he turns up beside her and they finish the form in step

tracks.title: แจ็กเก็ตยีนส์ตัวนั้น
tracks.genre: Thai trip-hop (dusty breakbeat, Rhodes and cello, late-night downtempo)
tracks.subject: Nit, browsing a Chatuchak second-hand stall, pulls a denim jacket off the rack and finds in the pocket a folded note in the handwriting of the best friend she stopped speaking to three years ago

tracks.title: ผ้าปะหนังตะลุง
tracks.genre: Southern Thai nang talung shadow-theatre song (rhythmic nora-style percussion, sung narration)
tracks.subject: A nang talung puppeteer in Phatthalung burns a hole in his clown puppet Nai Theng the night before a school fair, patches it with a pink sweet wrapper, and the whole screen glows pink to the children's delight

tracks.title: สามสิบสอง
tracks.genre: Lanna sueng-and-salo acoustic pop (Chiang Mai string-ensemble style)
tracks.subject: In a Lampang cloth shop, tailor Pa Noi measures old Lung Chan, who sucks in his belly every year, and quietly writes 32 in her notebook while leaving extra seam allowance for his real waist.

tracks.title: ร่มสิบเอ็ดคัน
tracks.genre: Thai 1990s new jack swing pop (Grammy-era dance-pop)
tracks.subject: A reception clerk in a Bangkok office keeps the umbrella that Nok forgets by his desk every Friday, now has eleven in his steel locker, and finally leaves one on her desk with a note.

tracks.title: ช่องเก้าแนวนอน
tracks.genre: Thai khrueang sai chamber pop (saw duang, khim and khlui)
tracks.mood: tender, quietly funny, slow morning warmth
tracks.subject: Every Sunday morning a retired husband secretly pencils wrong answers into the Thai crossword his wife fills in with a black pen, just so she will look up and scold him.

tracks.title: ปกเสื้อแข็ง
tracks.genre: Bangkok 1970s Philly-style string soul (Thai vintage soul)
tracks.subject: Jeh Lek irons office shirts for five baht each at a Silom alley stall and reads her customers from their collars: heavy starch means interview tomorrow, no starch means no sleep.

tracks.title: กระดิ่งคนลับมีด
tracks.genre: Bangkok ballroom cha-cha-chá orchestra song (1950s Latin dance orchestra)
tracks.subject: Every Wednesday old knife-grinder Lung Thong rings his bicycle bell down a Thonburi alley where nobody answers except Fon, age seven, who brings the same butter knife to be sharpened.

tracks.title: เห็ดดอกเดียวบนเนินเขา
tracks.genre: Thai highland Tibetan-style pop (dranyen and flute)
tracks.subject: Before dawn after the first rain on a hillside near Chiang Mai, forager Kaew and old Lung Boon grab the same giant mushroom at once, refuse to let go, then split it and boil it into soup on a stone fire.

tracks.title: ผีประจำตู้เจ็ด
tracks.subject: A scare actor at a Bangkok amusement-park ghost train who must leap out at car seven finds the same girl riding alone every Saturday, and today she waves at him and says hello, so he forgets his lines.

tracks.title: เชือกยาวสิบวา
tracks.genre: Argentine-style chacarera folk (6/8, guitar and bombo legüero)
tracks.mood: warm, teasing, quietly romantic dance feel
tracks.subject: A young hemp rope-maker in a riverside yard in Ayutthaya, walking backwards as he twists the strands, gets an order from a boat girl for a ten-wa rope to hang a hammock for two between two mango trees, and twists it slowly so she must come back.

tracks.title: ชื่อเธอใต้ป้ายแหวน
tracks.genre: 1980s power ballad AOR (big drums, synth pad, guitar solo)
tracks.subject: At 2 a.m. on a scaffold above a Bangkok Skytrain line, a billboard paster glues the giant panels of a diamond-ring advert and secretly writes his girlfriend's name and a proposal in the last corner, knowing she passes it at 8:10 every morning.

tracks.title: ไซริมห้วยของใคร
tracks.genre: Hill-tribe folk-pop (Karen/Akha style, bamboo flute and group chant)
tracks.subject: A young hill-village man checks his bamboo fish trap by the stream every morning and finds his fish swapped for wild bananas, then a flower, and follows small footprints in the mud to the headman's daughter by the footbridge.

tracks.title: ตีสี่กับหุ่นโชว์
tracks.genre: Thai Congolese soukous (rumba-derived guitar dance song)
tracks.subject: At 4 a.m. before a Siam department store opens, window dresser Noi pins a sequinned lime-green dress onto a stubborn mannequin, ends up swaying her around the display to fix the fit, and the manager walks in early.

tracks.title: ฟันบนอยู่ใต้ถุน
tracks.subject: Seven-year-old Prae throws her fallen upper tooth under her grandmother's stilt house, as custom says, then crawls under with her father's torch and finds a marble, an earring and grandpa's whistle but no tooth, while the hen eyes her.

tracks.title: สี่นาทีของลุงสม
tracks.genre: Thai ranat ek and string quartet chamber pop
tracks.subject: Uncle Som, keeper of a provincial clock tower in Phrae, climbs sixty-one steps each Sunday to wind it and sets it four minutes fast on purpose so the rushing townsfolk arrive on time, and he hides the key when the district office orders it corrected.

tracks.title: ทอนเจ็ดสิบห้า
tracks.genre: Thai 1960s Italian canzone pop (Sanremo-style strings and mandolin)
tracks.subject: Mon, a toll-booth attendant at lane three of a Bangkok expressway, has three seconds a day with the woman in the white car who always pays exact coins; the day she hands him a 100-baht note, he counts the 75 baht change slowly while she smiles and horns sound behind.

tracks.title: ร้อยสี่สิบสามแผ่น
tracks.genre: Thai choir-led gospel-soul with piano and hand claps
tracks.subject: A first-time father pacing outside a delivery room counts 143 ceiling tiles, clutching tiny socks he bought in May, until the nurse leaves the door ajar and he hears the first cry and sits down on the floor.

tracks.title: หมูย่างตะแกรงพัดลม
tracks.subject: Payday Friday at Ton's rented Lat Phrao townhouse: two kilos of marinated pork neck, a glowing charcoal stove and no grill rack, so he unscrews the front guard of their only standing fan and grills on it, leaving fan-striped pork and a bare fan.

tracks.title: เคี้ยวไปก่อน
tracks.subject: A Bangkok taxi driver, forty days after quitting cigarettes, chews mint gum at every red light while his wife folds each wrapper into a paper chain along their bedroom wall; tonight he learns half the wrappers are hers, chewed to keep him company.

tracks.title: ผัวฉันชื่อบักสีดา
tracks.subject: A Swedish son-in-law in an Udon Thani village, whose name Björn nobody can pronounce, is renamed Bak Sida (Isan for guava, hence farang) by his mother-in-law on day one; three years on he answers to nothing else and calls his wife Bak Hung, papaya.

tracks.title: เสื่อผืนเดิม
tracks.subject: A Bangkok couple have spread the same free plastic mat, printed with a tyre shop's name, อารักษ์การยาง, under one rain tree at Suan Rot Fai for eleven years; the print has rubbed away until only the รัก (love) inside อารักษ์ is left.

tracks.title: ทิลท์อีกแล้ว
tracks.subject: A Bangkok man called Pop shoves a pinball machine so hard at a Sam Yan arcade that it flashes TILT on every ball; the owner, Auntie Lek, tapes a sign on it, and the night he finally plays gently he wins a free game and has no idea what to do.

tracks.title: ผัวขึ้นบันได
tracks.genre: Central Thai luk thung stage-revue (wong luk thung with brass)
tracks.subject: a wife standing hands-on-hips at the foot of a ladder directing her husband, step by step, as he tries to fix the sagging kitchen gutter with silicone that ends up on him instead of the gutter

tracks.title: ห่อปกเล่มละห้าบาท
tracks.genre: Bangkok hot swing small-combo song (Lindy-hop revival)
tracks.subject: a schoolboy who sets up his old desk at the school gate on the first day of term charging five baht a book to cover textbooks in clear plastic, until the strict discipline teacher walks over and puts down three of her own notebooks

tracks.title: แมวส้มข้ามระเบียง
tracks.genre: Thai mahori-ensemble classical song (phleng Thai doem)
tracks.subject: a man whose neighbour's orange cat crosses onto his balcony every night, so each night he carries it back to her door, until the night the cat does not come and she knocks on his door herself

tracks.title: ไฮไลต์ทั้งเล่ม
tracks.subject: a student the night before a biology exam who highlights every single line of a friend's photocopied notes until three yellow pens run dry, falls asleep, and wakes with a page stuck to her cheek

tracks.title: นับหัวก่อนออกรถ
tracks.genre: Thai Gen-Z campus band pop-rock (Gene Lab style, upbeat)
tracks.subject: a student on a class trip to Kanchanaburi who is paired by roll number with number 24, the boy who never talks, and by the River Kwai bridge they are friends; on the way back the teacher counts thirty-nine and he runs back holding two ice creams

tracks.title: สงกรานต์ไม่อยากเปียก (Dry Songkran)
tracks.subject: a Chiang Mai office worker walking to work on Songkran morning in a raincoat and swim goggles with her laptop wrapped in three plastic bags, ambushed at every corner by the same six-year-old with a water gun, until she buys a bigger gun herself

tracks.title: ตีสามที่เซเว่น (3 A.M. at the 7-Eleven)
tracks.subject: a man who walks down to the 7-Eleven at three in the morning to wait for his girlfriend coming off a late shift, buying two ham-and-cheese toasties and eating them with her on the shop step under the fluorescent sign

tracks.title: ตุ๊กตุ๊กใจดี (The Soft-Hearted Tuk-Tuk)
tracks.genre: contemporary Central Thai phleng choi repartee
tracks.subject: a tuk-tuk driver in Ayutthaya and his wife trading phleng choi verses over his habit of giving free rides to every monk, schoolkid and old lady in the soi, until she counts sixty baht for a whole day and decides to ride along to keep the meter herself

tracks.title: ไฟส่องแถวหลัง (The Spotlight Drifts Back)
tracks.subject: the follow-spot operator at a travelling mor lam stage show whose job is to keep the light on the lead singer, and the night his daughter dances in the back row for the first time he keeps letting the beam drift to her

tracks.title: แบ่งครึ่งไว้บนชั้น (Half Left on the Shelf)
tracks.subject: two flatmates who start leaving half of whatever they cook on the shared fridge shelf with a sticky note giving it a score out of ten, the scores and the notes getting longer until one note just asks if the other wants to eat it together tonight

tracks.title: หมากฮอสฝาขวด (Bottle-Cap Checkers)
tracks.subject: a couple who play Thai checkers with beer bottle caps on a chalk board at their usual noodle shop every Friday, both so bad that no game has ever finished, and neither wants one to

tracks.title: ตาชั่งปากโป้ง (The Talking Scale)
tracks.subject: a man in Korat who drops a one-baht coin into the talking coin scale outside the 7-Eleven every evening to check his diet, and the scale announces his weight out loud to the whole queue of motorbike taxi riders

tracks.title: ไซซ์ L อีกแล้ว (Size L Again)
tracks.subject: a father who has bought his daughter's Grade 4 school uniform three times at the shop by her Thonburi school, too big, then too small, then too big again, because he refuses to bring her along to try it on

tracks.title: ปืนจุกก๊อกงานวัด (The Cork Gun at the Temple Fair)
tracks.subject: a young man at his village temple fair in Roi Et who spends three nights and all his money at the cork-gun stall, never knocking down a single cigarette pack, while the girl reloading the guns teases him

tracks.title: รองเท้าใหม่ไซซ์ใหญ่ (New Shoes, One Size Up)
tracks.subject: a nine-year-old girl in Phitsanulok on the first week of the May school term, walking in new black school shoes bought one size too big to last the year, toes stuffed with tissue, clacking down the corridor

tracks.title: หวานยี่สิบห้า (Twenty-Five Percent Sweet)
tracks.genre: Thai melodic hip-hop ballad with live band
tracks.subject: a young man in Bangkok who has memorised the exact sweetness his girlfriend orders, cha yen at twenty-five percent sugar less ice, and orders it for her every morning at the shop below their condo before she wakes

tracks.title: หนังสือที่ยืมไป (The Borrowed Book)
tracks.subject: a woman in Nakhon Pathom who finds a novel she borrowed from a school friend twelve years ago, still with the friend's name inside, and finally posts it back with a short note and a packet of dried mango

tracks.title: ป้ายราคาใหม่ (The New Price Board)
tracks.genre: Andaman rong ngeng revival dance song
tracks.subject: a Trang roast-pork breakfast shop owner who quietly raises the price by five baht on a new board, and every customer pays without noticing except one aunty who reads the board out loud each morning

tracks.title: แสตมป์ดวงที่สิบ (The Tenth Stamp)
tracks.subject: a university student whose coffee loyalty card is one stamp from a free drink, who keeps not ordering the tenth cup because she does not want a reason to stop visiting the barista

tracks.title: ยืนนิ่งบันไดเลื่อน (Standing Still on the Escalator)
tracks.subject: a Bangkok office worker at Asok BTS station who refuses to rush, standing perfectly still on the left of the escalator at rush hour while everyone runs past him on the right, and still catches the same train

tracks.title: แว่นแรก (First Glasses)
tracks.genre: Isan molam sing (fast electric phin dance)
tracks.subject: a Khon Kaen rice-truck driver at his first eye test who reads the letter chart wrong with total confidence and then sees the price of the frames

tracks.title: สีที่สิบห้า (The Fifteenth Colour)
tracks.genre: Thai Bakery Music-era alternative pop revival
tracks.mood: warm, unhurried and quietly in love
tracks.subject: a couple painting fifteen sample squares of almost-identical off-white on the wall of their first rented room and choosing by lamplight at midnight

tracks.title: ใบเสร็จจาง (Faded Receipt)
tracks.subject: trying to return a pair of too-short trousers at a department store refund counter with a thermal receipt that has faded to blank paper

tracks.title: เหมียวใต้ม้านั่ง (Cat Under the Bench)
tracks.mood: gentle, fond and a little comic
tracks.subject: a woman at a Nonthaburi vet clinic coaxing her ginger cat out from under the waiting-room bench for its yearly vaccine while a large dog watches politely

tracks.title: หนังสือที่ยืมครู (The Teacher's Book)
tracks.subject: a man in his forties posting back a dog-eared Thai poetry book he borrowed from his primary-school teacher thirty years ago, with a short letter tucked at page forty

tracks.title: ซ้อมมวยหลังเลิกงาน (After-Work Muay Thai)
tracks.subject: office workers in an after-work Muay Thai fitness class (a workout, not a fight), the trainer shouting for twenty more kicks while the accountant and the IT guy collapse on the mat, and everyone limping to work the next morning

tracks.title: ต้อนเป็ดข้ามถนน (Ducks Across the Road)
tracks.subject: a boy herding his family's two hundred ducks across a provincial highway at dusk with a bamboo pole and a red bag, while a ten-wheel truck and a pickup wait, and counting them all again on the far bank

tracks.title: รอน้ำพร้อม (Waiting for the Water)
tracks.subject: a couple who set up their first fish tank in a Nonthaburi condo and must wait six weeks for the water to cycle before buying a single betta, testing the water strip together every night

tracks.title: หมีตัวโตขึ้นวิน (Big Bear on the Bike Taxi)
tracks.subject: a woman who wins a giant pink teddy bear at a temple-fair ring toss and has to ride home on a motorcycle taxi with the bear squeezed between her and the driver, its ears covering his eyes

tracks.title: จีบนิ้วหน้ากระจก (Jeeb in the Mirror)
tracks.subject: a schoolgirl practising Thai classical dance hand curves (jeeb) in the wardrobe mirror every night for her school's Wai Khru day, her little brother copying her from the doorway with tangled fingers

tracks.title: ตำนี้ใครกินไหว (Who Can Eat This Somtam)
tracks.mood: rowdy, sweaty and laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a Bangkok office's Friday pot-luck where Pae from purchasing brings a somtam made with thirty bird's-eye chillies; one bite each sends the whole 14th floor queueing at the water cooler, while the narrator calmly keeps eating and becomes the only person Pae will pound it for

tracks.title: ไพ่ตองของยาย (Grandma's Tong Cards)
tracks.subject: a man spending his first Songkran at his girlfriend's family home learning her grandmother's tong card game to win the family over, losing every hand for three days, until the grandmother deals to him first and calls him หลาน

tracks.title: อ่านได้หมด (I Can Read Them All)
tracks.subject: a Roi Et rice farmer on his first trip abroad, a temple tour bus to Vientiane his daughter paid for, who bets the Lao driver a crate of Beerlao that he can read every Lao shop sign because it is nearly Isan, and loses to a French bakery sign and the railway station sign he reads as a discount on lights

tracks.title: สูบน้ำคืนเดือนสาม (Pumping Water in the Third Month)
tracks.subject: a young man running the diesel pump every dry-season night onto his family's shallot beds on the Chi river bank in Maha Sarakham, and the young woman who runs the pump on the next plot; they talk across the ditch over the engine noise until he offers to carry her pipe

tracks.title: บลูเบอร์รี่ป่า (Wild Blueberries)
tracks.mood: tired, wry and homesick but grinning
tracks.subject: a Chaiyaphum man on his third summer picking wild blueberries in the forests of Finnish Lapland, counting buckets at the scale each evening, cooking sticky rice in a borrowed school kitchen, and noticing the August sun is still up at eleven at night

tracks.title: ป้ายใหม่มาแล้ว (Here Comes the New Sign)
tracks.subject: the megaphone woman on a Bang Phlat district-office crew swapping the faded blue street-name signs down one soi in a single afternoon, announcing every stop through a megaphone while the aunties argue the new sign is spelled wrong, a noodle shop owner protests the two thousand business cards he printed with the old soi number, and kids pose for photos under each sign before the paint is dry

tracks.title: เลื่อยน้ำแข็ง (Ice Saw)
tracks.subject: a night-shift worker at a Bangkok ice plant during a 43-degree April heatwave, hauling 150-kilo blocks out of the brine tanks, sawing them into quarters and loading ten trucks before dawn, the only cold man in the city

tracks.title: จิ้งหรีดไม่ยอมร้อง (Silent Crickets)
tracks.subject: a cricket farmer outside Khon Kaen whose forty concrete rings of crickets chirp all night every night, until the man from a Bangkok protein-snack company comes to inspect and every ring goes silent, until her husband plays his electric phin and they start up again

tracks.title: มุมขวาล่าง (Bottom Right Corner)
tracks.subject: a deaf sign-language teacher in Chiang Mai who watches her husband, a former student from her Saturday class at the public library, interpret the northern regional evening news in the small box in the bottom-right corner of the screen; at the end of every bulletin he touches his collar twice, their sign that he is coming home

tracks.title: ซี่ลวดสามสิบหกซี่ (Thirty-Six Spokes)
tracks.genre: J-pop piano band rock (sung in Thai)
tracks.subject: a 19-year-old apprentice at an old Bangkok bicycle-repair shop rebuilding her first customer's rusted delivery bike spoke by spoke, watched by the shop owner, before the rider comes back to collect it at six

tracks.title: ฉายให้เธอคนเดียว (A Show for One)
tracks.subject: a husband and wife who have run the last single-screen cinema in Lampang for forty years, he threading the 35mm projectors upstairs and she selling tickets downstairs; on closing night he borrows a print of the film that was showing the night he first saw her from the Thai Film Archive and screens it for her alone in row F, deliberately missing the last reel changeover as he did in 1985 when he was watching her instead of the cue marks

tracks.title: ไดโนเสาร์คอยาว (The Long-Neck Dinosaur)
tracks.subject: a kindergarten class trip to the Sirindhorn Dinosaur Museum in Kalasin, where the children count the neck vertebrae of the long-neck sauropod skeleton out loud and keep losing count, a boy named Ton Kla insists a fossil egg in the glass case is his and wants to take it home to hatch, and the teacher hides behind the T-rex model and roars

tracks.title: ลงตมนำกัน (Mud For Two)
tracks.subject: the builder on his village's team at the Yasothon rocket festival, whose bamboo rocket hisses and sits on the launch ramp, and the girl from the rival team who claims the right to throw him into the mud pit herself, then jumps in after him before her own team's rocket is lit

tracks.title: สามหมื่นเมตร (Thirty Thousand Metres)
tracks.subject: a Mathayom 5 girl in a provincial school science club who spent a year's lunch money on a weather balloon carrying a small camera, sitting on the school football field the night before the launch and wanting to see her own town from thirty kilometres up

tracks.title: เทริดคือหมวกกันน็อก (My Crown's My Helmet)
tracks.subject: a Nora dancer hired by the provincial transport office to perform helmet verses at Phatthalung schools, who tells six hundred students his beaded crown is his helmet, then sees the headmaster ride off bareheaded and improvises a verse about him over the school loudspeakers

tracks.title: ทุเรียนเต้นได้ (Dancing Durian)
tracks.mood: sweaty, giddy and proud of it
tracks.subject: a woman inside a giant durian mascot suit dancing the shows every two hours at a shopping mall's durian fair, seeing the crowd only through the mesh mouth

tracks.title: เสือขยิบตา (The Tiger Winked)
tracks.subject: a Mathayom 4 boy in the school sports-day card-stunt stand who flips to the wrong page and puts a white dot in the giant tiger's eye in front of the whole school

tracks.title: หมาจำผมได้ (The Dogs Know Me)
tracks.subject: a parcel courier on a Pak Kret housing-estate route who knows every dog on it by name, and the old brown dog that guards a parcel for him when nobody is home

tracks.title: สองแปดเจ็ด (Two-Eight-Seven)
tracks.subject: a father who vowed a kae-bon likay show to the village shrine if his son passed the police-cadet exam, sitting in the front row in a pressed white shirt while the likay prince weaves the son's name and his score of 287 into the plot

tracks.title: ฉาบคู่นี้ (These Cymbals)
tracks.subject: the cymbal player in a hired long-drum troupe who has played behind the same woman dancing at the head of every merit procession for six years, and this kathin hands his cymbals to the new boy and walks up front to dance beside her

tracks.title: หวานยี่สิบห้า (25% Sweet)
tracks.subject: the office junior who takes the bubble-tea order for the whole floor in the group chat and gets every sweetness level wrong

tracks.title: ขบวนสุดท้าย (Last Train)
tracks.subject: running for the last BTS train at midnight with your heels in your hand after a friend's birthday dinner

tracks.title: ชั่วโมงละสามร้อย (300 An Hour)
tracks.subject: two friends renting a rehearsal room by the hour in Saphan Khwai and racing the wall clock to finish one song before the owner knocks

tracks.title: ตัวเงินตัวทอง (Lumpini Lizard)
tracks.subject: an office worker who eats lunch on the same Lumpini Park bench every day beside a monitor lizard he has named after his boss

tracks.title: พริกเม็ดแรก (First Chili)
tracks.subject: a couple growing chilli and holy basil in paint buckets on their condo balcony and waking early to check whether the first chilli has turned red

tracks.title: มุ้งหลังแรก
tracks.subject: a young couple hanging a mosquito net in their first rented room, arguing over which corner goes where, then lying under it listening to the rain

tracks.title: ลดอีกสิบบาท
tracks.subject: two strangers selling T-shirts at neighbouring stalls at Chatuchak weekend market who undercut each other by ten baht all Saturday, then split one plate of pad thai at closing

tracks.title: แหล่ปลดหนี้กระบะ
tracks.subject: a pickup driver paying the last of seventy-two monthly instalments and announcing it to the whole village in a lae

tracks.title: ไม้กวาดตีสี่
tracks.subject: a city street sweeper in an orange vest on her four a.m. shift on Sukhumvit, sweeping past clubbers spilling out and moving to the bass that leaks from the doors

tracks.title: ลุงจูนเสา
tracks.subject: an uncle on the soi who climbs every neighbour's roof to fix their TV antenna and shouts down asking whether the picture is back

tracks.title: หมวกใบที่สอง (The Second Helmet)
tracks.genre: Central Thai luk thung ballad (Suphan Buri style)
tracks.subject: keeping a boyfriend's helmet hooked on the scooter in Suphan Buri for the two years he works in a Korean factory

tracks.title: ที่นอนยังอุ่น (Still Warm)
tracks.mood: sleepy, devoted and still smitten at seven in the morning
tracks.subject: a young married couple on opposite shifts sharing one rented room in Bang Na, she home from a bakery night shift at half past six, he leaving for a building site at seven, and the half hour at the door that is their whole day together

tracks.title: ผีสวนยาง (Rubber Grove Ghost)
tracks.genre: Southern Thai string sator luk thung
tracks.subject: a rubber tapper at two in the morning sure a ghost is knocking over his latex cups, until his head torch finds the neighbour's goat

tracks.title: ฝั่งนี้ (This Side)
tracks.genre: ramwong yon yuk temple-fair circle dance
tracks.subject: a ramwong band at a temple fair trying to win the crowd back from the likay stage across the yard, until the likay hero comes over after his show, still in make-up, and buys a coupon

tracks.title: วิทยุเสีย (Radio's Broken)
tracks.subject: driving from Bangkok to Hua Hin on a Friday night in a car with a dead radio, the two of you singing every song yourselves and missing the high notes

tracks.title: รถเกี่ยวคันแดง (Red Harvester)
tracks.subject: the only woman in a Surin district who drives a combine harvester, and the men who said she couldn't now queueing to book her first

tracks.title: ตัวสำรอง (The Sub)
tracks.subject: a school troupe's drum carrier who gets to play lead pong lang at the Kalasin festival because the regular player broke his arm falling out of a mango tree
